presence_rationale: Substantive systemic-risk disclosure: APRA approved detailed Integrated Plan to strengthen risk governance across financial and non-financial risk. Westpac participating in APRA Climate Vulnerability Assessment with 4 other major banks. NZ climate-related disclosure mandate (likely 2023). 13 customer transactions escalated to Sustainability Committee where climate was material.
specificity_rationale: Names APRA Integrated Plan (post-prior-incident remediation), APRA Climate Vulnerability Assessment with 4 other banks, NZ Financial Sector (Climate-related Disclosures and Other Matters) Amendment Bill, IPCC RCP2.6 / RCP8.5 scenarios, Building Code of Australia / AS/NZS1170.2.2011 baseline for cyclone wind speed analysis. APRA Prudential Practice Guide CPG 229 referenced.
quantification_rationale: Reports 13 customer transactions escalated where climate was material. APRA CVA expected publication in 2022. However, no G-SIB or D-SIB score in retrieved chunks, no CET1/leverage/LCR/NSFR ratios disclosed in this Sustainability Supplement (these live in Annual Report). SASB FN-CB-550a.1 not in retrieved evidence; SASB FN-CB-550a.2 partially covered through APRA CVA participation and Integrated Plan.
